function disarmCardBurn(host, i): void

Defined in: website/components/home/mosaic/burn.ts:131

Un-arms the burn by reversing it: the consume front descends and un-chars the glyphs until the title raster is whole again — the same effect played backwards, not an instant DOM-ink pop. prog captures where the burn stopped so the front returns from exactly the consumed edge; frame() runs the teardown once the text is rebuilt. A card with no session (reduced motion, never armed) restores instantly — safe to call unconditionally.

host
